config.description: containerd configuration object. All top-level keys mirror the TOML structure of the real config file, with nested objects for sections like plugins, grpc, etc. Only replace site-specific values — preserve all sections, comments, and directive order exactly as in the shipped config file.

plugins.description: Top-level [plugins] section and its sub-sections (e.g., CRI, opt). Only the values that an admin would change are parametrized.

plugins.cri.description: CRI plugin config ([plugins."io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri"]) — reused from provided schema, only extended with new keys needed for verbatim config.

plugins.cri.cni.bin_dir.description: Path to CNI binary plugins (reused from real config — /usr/lib/cni in Debian package default).

plugins.cri.cni.conf_dir.description: Path to CNI configuration directory (reused from real config — /etc/cni/net.d in Debian package default).

plugins.opt.description: Internal opt plugin config ([plugins."io.containerd.internal.v1.opt"]) — new section not in prior schema but present in real config.

plugins.opt.path.description: Path for opt plugin storage (reused from real config — /var/lib/containerd/opt).
